# VidaNexus AI

> VidaNexus is a modern AI workspace designed for creators, publishers, and growth-focused businesses. We build practical tools that turn real-time data, search trends, and research into high-performing content.

## Core Platform Capabilities

- **AI Keyword Spy Radar**: Continuous competitor search monitoring, zero-day trend discovery, and topical authority mapping.
- **Discover Headlines Intelligence**: High-CTR semantic title generation optimized for Google Discover, Google News, and social feeds.
- **Pro AI Article Writer**: Long-form, research-grounded article generation with live Google News fact integration and custom persona control.
- **Trending Search Monitor**: 24/7 global agency and search trend monitoring with real-time virality scoring.
